title: Give a function inputs with takes
objective: Declare the inputs a function needs with takes, and call it with values of the right kind.

body.text: A function can take inputs, called parameters. Each one is a takes line that gives its kind and name, such as takes number called left. When you call the function, you give one value for each parameter, in the same order. Inside the function, the parameter is a name you can use like any other variable.

body.title: Greet with a text input
body.code:
function greet
    takes text called name
    say "Hello, {name}!"

greet "Grace"

body.text: A function can take several inputs. Give each one its own takes line, and separate the values in the call with and.

body.title: Two numbers
body.code:
function add
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left plus right

say add 4 and 5

body.text: A parameter can also be a list, or a pair. Write takes a list of number called scores for a list, and takes a pair of number and number called point for a pair. The call passes a list or pair in the same form.

body.title: A list and a pair
body.code:
function print names
    takes a list of text called names
    repeat for each name in names
        say name

print names a list of "Ana", "Bo"

function describe point
    takes a pair of number and number called point
    say point

describe point a pair of 3 and 4

body.prompt: The greet function is written but never used, so the program prints nothing. Make it print Hello, Ada!
body.starter:
